claim_boundary: Development computational mechanism pilot; not physical product, confirmatory statistics or RSI efficacy.
failure_rule: Retain every claimed cell, blocked run, error and timeout; no silent replacement.
falsifier: No matched advantage, or any advantage vanishes against a strong equal-information baseline.
free_scope_baseline: One explicit model scope-selection call before the common repair generator; its cost counts toward the same three-call cap. Not an unrestricted coding agent.
generator: Direct model completion through existing guarded provider proxy; not a Pi SDK session.
hypothesis: Repair-scope selection changes verified search outcomes under the same generator and budget.
pilot_scope: Injected circuit/classifier/schedule artifact constraints; not the physical co-design A study.
primary_metric: externally verified success within total trial budget
promotion: none; formal protocol requires later separate frozen confirmation
revision_reason: Unify artifact IDs in both selector and generator; common interface correction applied to every arm.
selector: Fixed heuristic closure, no learned-policy efficacy claim.
shared_knowledge: All arms receive the same public state, tool contracts and operator library.
statistic_unit: starting state/change/rule; events are not independent samples
